property_summary: For any caller address a and any newOwner address x, if the caller a is equal to the current owner then calling setOwner(x) succeeds and c.owner() equals x afterwards; the mutant inverts the onlyOwner check so some owner-calls that should succeed instead revert (or fail to update owner), which the fuzzer can find.
change_summary: Invert the require condition so only non-owners can execute functions guarded by onlyOwner.
